label: A CONTINGENT_1 actual concrete being populates the route's world (Cogito node)
description: Assembly (a weakening, not a substantive derivation): the contingency node's witness is concrete and exists at w, so the route's population node holds. It puts the node on the root path as an alternative derivation of STMT-COGITO-INHABITED-CONCRETE-WORLD; as an assembly it closes that node only if the contingency node is closed (invariant 16 fixpoint). It is deliberately not registered as a strengthens relation: a registration's backing argument is set aside by the reaching-root walk, so the node would stay off the root path. The converse fails (CONTINGENT-NODE-CONTROLS: on the one-world frame the world is inhabited and no being is contingent).
